GenStone interior stone veneer panels are on sale now ! GenStone’s interior stone veneer allows you to bring the beauty of stone into your home. Our interior line of panels are popular choices for those looking to complete fireplace surrounds, accent walls, and bar areas among other projects. The authentic look and feel of our interior stone veneer panels combined with the GenStone Made Easy installation system make GenStone an easy choice for a DIY project that you can truly do yourself.

This easy to install panelized system goes from the box to the wall in minutes making any interior stone veneer project achievable for the ordinary homeowner without mortar and mess. Starting with the stone veneer panels below, use the filter to view the entire GenStone system or click into the color of your choice to see projects and the pieces used from the system of the particular color that you are considering.

Need Help? Tap Project SOS and we will assign your project to a Project Coordinator out of our office in Colorado . Your Project Coordinator will guide you through color selection, how much GenStone you need and be your single point of contact for any installation questions you may have along the way.
